annotations.title: Form 2290 heavy vehicle use tax calculator

description: Estimate the heavy highway vehicle use tax for one truck, with the partial-period amount for a truck first used after July. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

baseTax.description: Annual tax for category A (55,000 lb) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual tax for category a (55,000 lb). Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 100 USD from IRS Form 2290 (Rev. July 2026), Tax Computation table, effective 2026-07-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

category.description: Form 2290 category. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for form 2290 category. Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when weightMode is category; ignored otherwise. Options: A = A: 55,000 lb; B = B: 55,001 to 56,000 lb; C = C: 56,001 to 57,000 lb; D = D: 57,001 to 58,000 lb; E = E: 58,001 to 59,000 lb; F = F: 59,001 to 60,000 lb; G = G: 60,001 to 61,000 lb; H = H: 61,001 to 62,000 lb; I = I: 62,001 to 63,000 lb; J = J: 63,001 to 64,000 lb; K = K: 64,001 to 65,000 lb; L = L: 65,001 to 66,000 lb; M = M: 66,001 to 67,000 lb; N = N: 67,001 to 68,000 lb; O = O: 68,001 to 69,000 lb; P = P: 69,001 to 70,000 lb; Q = Q: 70,001 to 71,000 lb; R = R: 71,001 to 72,000 lb; S = S: 72,001 to 73,000 lb; T = T: 73,001 to 74,000 lb; U = U: 74,001 to 75,000 lb; V = V: over 75,000 lb.

expectedMiles.description: Expected public-highway miles in the tax period (mi). All miles on public highways from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, in any vehicle this truck is part of.

limitAg.description: Mileage use limit for suspended tax, agricultural vehicles (mi). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for mileage use limit for suspended tax, agricultural vehicles. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 7500 mi from IRS Instructions for Form 2290 (Rev. 07/2026), effective 2026-07-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when use is ag; ignored otherwise.

limitRegular.description: Mileage use limit for suspended tax (mi). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for mileage use limit for suspended tax. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 5000 mi from IRS Instructions for Form 2290 (Rev. 07/2026), effective 2026-07-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when use is regular; ignored otherwise.

logging.description: Vehicle type. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for vehicle type. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: no = Not a logging vehicle; yes = Logging vehicle.

maxTax.description: Maximum annual tax (category V, over 75,000 lb) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for maximum annual tax (category v, over 75,000 lb). Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 550 USD from IRS Form 2290 (Rev. July 2026), Tax Computation table, effective 2026-07-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

month.description: Month of first use on public highways in this tax period. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for month of first use on public highways in this tax period. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: jul = July 2026; aug = August 2026; sep = September 2026; oct = October 2026; nov = November 2026; dec = December 2026; jan = January 2027; feb = February 2027; mar = March 2027; apr = April 2027; may = May 2027; jun = June 2027.

pounds.description: Taxable gross weight (lb). Unloaded weight of the truck and any trailers customarily used with it, plus the heaviest load customarily carried. Often the registered gross weight. Used only when weightMode is pounds; ignored otherwise.

stepTax.description: Added annual tax for each further 1,000 lb category (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for added annual tax for each further 1,000 lb category. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 22 USD from IRS Form 2290 (Rev. July 2026), Tax Computation table, effective 2026-07-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

use.description: Use type for the mileage limit. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for use type for the mileage limit. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: regular = Regular use; ag = Agricultural vehicle.

weightMode.description: How to enter weight. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for how to enter weight. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: pounds = Taxable gross weight in pounds; category = Form 2290 category letter.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
